excerpt.summary: This drawing illustrates the fuel gas distribution system for a gas generator and a fuel gas metering package. It includes supply lines from an export booster compressor, pressure control loops, relief valve configurations, and connections to a gas calorimeter.

observations.observation: Single PSV 4832 installed on the fuel gas generator inlet line without a redundant or secondary pressure relief path.
Potential for blocked discharge paths if the manual block valves downstream of PSV 4832 or 4833 are inadvertently closed during maintenance.
Lack of clear indication of independent high-pressure shutdown (PSH) interlocks on the main fuel gas feed line before the metering package.
The fuel gas calorimeter supply line (45-XX50) appears to be connected upstream of primary pressure regulation, potentially subjecting downstream components to full line pressure.
